results.evidence: In duplicateInsight, `if (redirectToInsight) { sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false) ...` closes the scene panel before redirecting, so an overlay panel no longer covers the copy.
The toast `lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` is unchanged, and `router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` still runs right after the panel close.
The close is unconditional: `setScenePanelOpen(false)` has no check for overlay vs docked presentation. sceneLayoutLogic isn't shown, so I can't tell whether this action affects a docked panel.

The transfer URL doesn't carry the short id. Instead the transfer logic resolves it: `insightsApi.getByNumericId(Number(logicProps.resourceId))` returns `insight?.short_id`. That gives the page the short id, which is the behaviour the criterion needs. `getByNumericId` isn't shown, so I'm assuming it exists.
`case 'Insight': return insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()`. When the short id has loaded, Back uses the insight view URL instead of the numeric id.
When `insightShortId` is null (not resolved, or none available), sourceResourceUrl returns `urls.savedInsights()`, the insights list.

The Dashboard case still returns `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and the Survey case still returns `urls.survey(resourceId)`. No URL parameters were added, and `afterMount` only loads the short id when `resourceKind === 'Insight'`.

The card gets `@container`, and the illustration is wrapped as `
{illustration}
`. Below the container's sm width the illustration is hidden, so the text takes the full width of the narrow modal.
